Diego: kicking off cyclone21b-v1-int4 canary. hitting OOMs on multi-turns when users ask followups. p50 looks fine but p99 blows during KV warm allocations. small log: 

Diego: ```
[2026-03-24T09:12:03Z] runtime:error cudaMalloc failed: out of memory
model=cyclone21b-v1-int4 shard=2 seq_len=384 batch=2 new_tokens=180
KV_cache_percent=81 slab_frag=0.46
stack: serve.cc:210 alloc_kv.cu:94
```

Nina: can you paste the canary config? microbatch/prefetch/max_new_tokens?

Diego: current canary config:```
model: cyclone21b-v1-int4
replicas: 5
microbatch_size: 2
batch_timeout_ms: 12
prefetch: aggressive
warmstart: enabled
max_new_tokens_default: 256
slot_reserve: 0.08
soft_evict: false
```

Theo: that slab_frag=0.46 is screaming fragmentation + aggressive prefetch. two quick levers: 1) reduce peak allocation by lowering max_new_tokens_default and microbatch; 2) give allocator more cushion with slot_reserve + soft_evict + a conservative kv_trim. Proposed canary overrides below. Also add microbatch_join_ms to smooth bursts.

Theo: rollout suggestion:```
set rollout.cyclone21b.canary {
  overrides: {
    prefetch: "streamed",
    microbatch_size: 1,
    microbatch_join_ms: 7,
    batch_timeout_ms: 10,
    max_new_tokens_default: 128,
    slot_reserve: 0.20,
    soft_evict: true,
    kv_trim_pct: 0.30
  }
}
```
